properties.displayName: AZ-DET-012 - Role Grant Followed by Diagnostic Change
properties.description: Successful role assignment followed strictly within fifteen minutes by a diagnostic setting write/delete by the same caller in the same subscription/resource group. Resource-group correlation does not prove equal RBAC/diagnostic target scope or causal privilege use. Disabled lab definition; no incident creation or automation.
properties.query:
let activity = materialize(
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(1h) .. now())
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write", "Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/write", "Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/delete")
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where isnotempty(EventDataId)
| extend TargetResourceId = coalesce(ResourceId, _ResourceId)
| extend SourceIPAddress = iff(CallerIpAddress !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(CallerIpAddress)), CallerIpAddress, "")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, SourceIPAddress, TargetResourceId, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId, EventDataId, SubscriptionId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventDataId
| where isnotempty(Caller) and isnotempty(ResourceGroup) and isnotempty(SubscriptionId)
| extend CallerKey = tolower(Caller), ScopeKey = tolower(strcat(SubscriptionId, "/", ResourceGroup))
);
let grants = activity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write"
| project CallerKey, ScopeKey, RoleTime=TimeGenerated, RoleEventDataId=EventDataId, RoleResourceId=TargetResourceId;
activity
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/write", "Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings/delete")
| join kind=inner grants on CallerKey, ScopeKey
| where TimeGenerated > RoleTime and TimeGenerated <= RoleTime + 15m
| extend RoleOrderKey = strcat(format_datetime(RoleTime, "yyyyMMddHHmmssfffffff"), "|", RoleEventDataId)
| summarize arg_max(RoleOrderKey, *) by EventDataId
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, SourceIPAddress, TargetResourceId, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId, EventDataId, RoleTime, RoleEventDataId, RoleResourceId
